blurb:
Hop aboard **Nashville’s #1 Tour**—the *ONLY* sing-along bus in the city—and get ready for a ride that’s loud, hilarious, and completely unforgettable! Recently voted **Top Tour in Tennessee**, this isn’t just sightseeing… it’s a full-blown, boots-stompin’, laugh-out-loud EXPERIENCE. 

*WARNING: THIS RIDE IS 21+ ONLY! This is an *adult-themed show* packed with bawdy humor, playful antics, adult humor and zero filters. If you’re easily offended… this might not be your jam. 

Your Hosts: Grammy Winner Cousin Gil & Comedian Jenny Carson will bring big vocals, bigger laughs, and plenty of moments where YOU become part of the show!

As seen on *Good Morning America* and HGTV, this award-winning ride is one of Nashville’s hottest tickets—and trust us, it SELLS OUT FAST.

*A cell phone is required to complete your reservation. Groups of 6+ must call directly to book (online tickets will NOT be valid for larger groups) 

**This isn’t just a tour… it’s a party on wheels, Nashville-style!**
